mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password, nickname, provider, role, place_id) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, 'LOCAL', 'USER', NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, updated_at = now() WHERE email = #{username} AND provider = 'LOCAL'
